items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: When I was leading the band, I was drafted. Of course, I was drafted and Oren was drafted and Johnny Duff was drafted. I kept them back.

ctx.x: You're right. You're right. You see, he'd have called Oren them to come out here. He said for Oren them to come out here. Around 1920 or 21.
That was Claybone. What was it? Well, 1919, was the press? What was it?
